sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, lane usage, turning, changing lanes and roundabouts

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A03
Entering a roundabout you yield to traffic from your left, but once inside you have the right of way over drivers waiting to enter. [A03]
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F23, sec08-F27 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A03
In a roundabout you do not stop for an approaching emergency vehicle; you leave by the nearest exit and only then pull right and stop. [A03]
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F28 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A03
You enter a roundabout by merging with the counterclockwise flow and exit by turning right, never by turning left. [A03]
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F24, sec08-F26 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A03
Missing your roundabout exit is fixed by circling around again, not by stopping or changing lanes inside the circle. [A03]
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F29, sec08-F32 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A01
A paved median cut-through with no prohibiting sign may be used for a left turn, while driving across median strips or through barriers is illegal. [A01]
Why it matters: group lane use; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F10 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A01
On a freeway, an empty left lane with no one right behind or ahead of you is a listed reason you may drive there, while weaving through traffic is never allowed. [A01]
Why it matters: group lane use; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06, sec08-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
A lane change to the left starts with a head check behind and to your left, while a change to the right checks behind and to your right. [A02]
Why it matters: group turning; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F21 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A02
In a double turn lane, staying in your matching lane prevents cutting off the driver turning beside you. [A02]
Why it matters: group turning; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F16, sec08-F19 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A02
While waiting to turn left, hold the front wheels straight ahead and turn them only as the turn begins. [A02]
Why it matters: group turning; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F18 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A03
At a railroad crossing with a train coming you stop between 15 and 50 feet from the tracks, and the lower limit matters since trains overhang the rails by at least three feet. [A03]
Why it matters: group railroad; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F35, sec08-F36 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0049]
